reading_note: The teaching describes the threefold arc of judgment by which Divine Truth subdues and finally seals the love of self. First, the ruling self-love is separated from the goods it had infested and bound in the Living Principle (held in check by influx of life). Second, in the great fire of judgment, the inner forms of falsity (icons) are dissolved, the goods hidden within them are gathered home, and the falsity rebound according to its first type. Third and finally, in the consummation, every quality is sorted: the active falsity (male) is bound in the lump (the prison of hell), while the receptive falsity (female) is sealed in the tomb of stone — a permanent state of hardened evil from which no dissolution is possible. The arc moves from initial restraint, through purgative separation, to eternal sealing.
